summary: This standards-track memo defines a name form called a permanent identifier, which can go in the subjectAltName extension of an X.509 certificate. A certification authority can use it to show that several certificates belong to the same entity, even if the names differ.

eli5.summary: People can change their names, but a number on their ID card stays the same. This adds such a lasting number to digital certificates.

questions: what is an x509 permanent identifier
how to link certificates to the same entity
